title: Pumping Ironic-i-tude
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Work out with Gertie on the nearby Heavy Bag. Afterward, spar with any 5 tough guys in Upper MutantMania. When you're done, check in with Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Work out with Gertie on the nearby Heavy Bag. Afterward, spar with any 5 tough guys in Upper MutantMania. When you're done, check in with Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Hello again! That workout we did last time was great. I felt so invigorated! *Giggle!* Can we do it again?

After you're done helping me with the heavy bag, Colonel Cabo told me you're supposed to spar with some of the local tough guys from Upper MutantMania.

When you're all done, don't forget to check in with Colonel Cabo! *Grin!*

Turn-in:

Ah trust...Ah say, Ah trust you had a good workout with Grapplin' Gertie? You and she are going to go all the way, friend. All the way to the top! Championship, that is!

Objectives:

  • Spar with 5 Local Tough Guys

Level range: 82–84
